Karnataka Launches Doorstep Delivery of Caste Certificates

The Indian state of Karnataka has launched a doorstep delivery service for caste and residence certificates, aiming to improve accessibility for citizens. The initiative is part of the state's efforts to streamline its bureaucracy and provide better services to its residents. This move is expected to benefit those who face difficulties in obtaining these documents due to geographical or mobility constraints.
